title: Crane
description: The traditional crane, folded through the square base and the bird base.

steps.title: Book folds
tips: Or turn over and valley-crease them.

steps.title: Square base
steps.instruction: Collapse into a square base, open end down.
tips: All four corners meet at the bottom.

steps.title: Left edge in
steps.instruction: Fold the front left edge to the centre line.
mistakes: Folding all the layers at once.

steps.title: Right edge in
steps.instruction: Fold the front right edge to the centre line.
tips: The two edges meet on the centre line, like a kite.

steps.title: Petal fold
steps.instruction: Lift the front point up; the sides fold in.
tips: Crease the top line first, then lift along it.
mistakes: Letting the side flaps pop out.

steps.title: Turn over
tips: The back is still a plain square base.

steps.title: Edge in again
steps.instruction: Fold this side's lower edge to the centre.
mistakes: Folding the petal you already made.

steps.title: Other edge in
steps.instruction: Fold the other lower edge to the centre.

steps.title: Second petal
tips: Now you have the bird base.
steps.check: A long diamond with two legs at the bottom.

steps.title: Narrow leg
steps.instruction: Narrow the inner leg along its kite crease.
tips: This happens as the petals rise; tidy it here.

steps.title: Narrow leg
steps.instruction: Narrow the other side of that leg.
tips: The leg becomes a thin point.

steps.title: Second leg
steps.instruction: Narrow the second leg the same way.

steps.title: Second leg
steps.check: The bird base with two thin legs.

steps.title: Point up
steps.instruction: Rotate so the petals point up.
tips: The two thin legs now point down.

steps.title: Neck
steps.instruction: Inside-reverse fold one leg up for the neck.
tips: Open the layers slightly and push the leg up between them.
mistakes: Folding the leg outside the body.

steps.title: Tail
steps.instruction: Reverse fold the other leg up for the tail.
mistakes: A tail at a different angle from the neck.

steps.title: Head
steps.instruction: Reverse fold the tip of the neck down.
tips: A small head looks more natural.
mistakes: A head as long as the neck.

steps.title: Wings
steps.instruction: Fold the wings down and spread them.
tips: Blow gently into the hole underneath to puff the body.
mistakes: Pulling the wings too hard at the centre.
steps.check: A crane with neck, tail and wings.
steps.note: Fold the wings down and gently pull them apart to shape the body.
